interactive.label: Load
interactive.tooltip: Open an fps.json labelling file (a dropped .json file does the same).

interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Save the whole configuration as an fps.json file.

interactive.label: Update
interactive.tooltip: Update the editor from the text of the JSON tab.

interactive.label: Clear
interactive.tooltip: Remove all positions and distances to start from scratch (asks first).

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: A step-by-step walk through the tool, pointing at each control.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: What the tool does, what it writes, and its limits.

interactive.label: Add Row
interactive.tooltip: Add an empty position row; it becomes a position once it has a name.

interactive.label: Delete Row
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected row (asks first; the distances that use a position go with it).

interactive.label: Browse PDB...
interactive.tooltip: Choose the structure file of the selected row.

interactive.label: Fetch PDB...
interactive.tooltip: Download a structure from the RCSB by its 4-character ID: for the selected row, else a new row on it. Typing the ID into PDB file or ID does the same.

interactive.label: ◀ Residue
interactive.tooltip: Move the selected position to the previous residue of its chain; its volume is recomputed and shown in the 3D View.

interactive.label: Residue ▶
interactive.tooltip: Move the selected position to the next residue of its chain; its volume is recomputed and shown in the 3D View.

interactive.label: Compute AVs
interactive.tooltip: Recompute the accessible volume of every named position.

interactive.label: Save AV MRC
interactive.tooltip: Save the selected position's computed accessible volume (else every one) as an MRC density map.

interactive.label: p_pdb
interactive.tooltip: The structure file of the row, or a four-character PDB ID that is downloaded. Press Enter to load it.

interactive.label: p_color
interactive.tooltip: Colour of the accessible volume (the transparency stays as it was).

interactive.label: linker_length
interactive.tooltip: Length of the flexible linker.

interactive.label: linker_width
interactive.tooltip: Width of the linker.

interactive.label: radius1
interactive.tooltip: First dye radius.

interactive.label: radius2
interactive.tooltip: Second dye radius (AV3 only).

interactive.label: radius3
interactive.tooltip: Third dye radius (AV3 only).

interactive.label: Add Scoring Group
interactive.tooltip: Add a scoring group (a chi-squared set of restraints).

interactive.label: Remove Scoring Group
interactive.tooltip: Remove the scoring group shown in the filter (asks first).

interactive.label: scorefilter
interactive.tooltip: Show only the restraints of one scoring group, or all of them.

interactive.label: Forster_radius
interactive.tooltip: Forster radius of the dye pair in angstrom.

interactive.label: distance
interactive.tooltip: The measured distance in angstrom.

interactive.label: error_neg
interactive.tooltip: Lower error of the distance.

interactive.label: error_pos
interactive.tooltip: Upper error of the distance.

interactive.label: flexset
interactive.tooltip: The FlexFit set whose residues and bonds are shown.
Add a new FlexFit set.
Remove the current FlexFit set.

interactive.label: Add residue
interactive.tooltip: Add a flexible residue to the set.

interactive.label: Remove selected residue
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected residue row.

interactive.label: Add bond
interactive.tooltip: Add a bond (two atoms) to the set.

interactive.label: Remove selected bond
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected bond row.

interactive.label: body_id
interactive.tooltip: The rigid body the position belongs to (docking).

interactive.label: allowed_sphere_radius
interactive.tooltip: Radius of the sphere around the attachment point where the dye may clash.

interactive.label: simulation_grid_resolution
interactive.tooltip: Grid spacing of the accessible volume, in angstrom.

interactive.label: anchor_atoms
interactive.tooltip: Atoms the linker is anchored to, if not the attachment atom.

interactive.label: strip_mask
interactive.tooltip: Atoms removed before the volume is computed.

interactive.label: Chain weighting
interactive.tooltip: Weight the sampled positions by the chain length.

interactive.label: contact_volume_thickness
interactive.tooltip: Thickness of the contact volume around the surface.

interactive.label: contact_volume_trapped_fraction
interactive.tooltip: Fraction of dyes trapped in the contact volume; -1 = not used.

interactive.label: min_sphere_volume_fraction
interactive.tooltip: Smallest accepted fraction of the sphere volume.
